answer_4.quote: We conduct an extensive user experiment to evaluate the performance of AXIS.
answer_4.guideline: Participants are asked to complete specified tasks within an application through three methods: manually, with the assistance of a UI Agent, and with the assistance of AXIS. Post-task questionnaires include NASA-TLX metrics and learning effort, agent fluency/reliability, UI dependency, decision consistency, and perceived completion speed.
